map.：输入：牙根长度 L=13mm，根尖片上剩余骨高度 H=5.2mm\n计算：骨吸:
: input: root length L=13mm, remaining bone height on the periapical radiograph H=5.2mm
Calculation: bone resorption proportion = (1 − H/L) × 100% = (1 − 5.2/13) × 100% ≈ 60%
Judgement: > 1/2 of the root length is grade III bone resorption, indicating clear loss of supporting tissue, so bone augmentation must be assessed before implantation.
